In both cases GPI is less than 1.00 which indicates that the system is favouring more boys than girls. Therefore the equity of both primary and secondary education needs to be more improved to increase GPI and then towards to 1.00. It can be observed that the GPI in primary education is better than the GPI in the secondary education.
